note: THIS PROFILE IS INVENTED. Every other profile in this directory was read out of a real GDTF file under mvr/gdtf/; there is no laser GDTF in this repo, so the channel map below is made up and matches no fixture you can buy. It exists because preflight.js carries a laser_sweep sequence that no rig here could ever run -- nothing declared the `laser` capability -- and a hero look that is permanently unreachable is worse than one behind a gate. The gate is real: the sequence is still withheld unless the layout also declares limits.laser_zones, so a rig that has not stated its safe zones does not get it. Replace this with a profile read from the real fixture's GDTF before anything is pointed at a room with people in it.
